properties.name_en: Garden of Clear Ripples (颐和园 Yihe Yuan from 1888)
properties.state_1860: looted 6-16 Oct 1860, burned 18-19 Oct by British troops under Michel (S02 pp.188-189; memorials of 宝鋆 16 Oct and 瑞常 26 Oct via S1207); rebuilt 1886-1895 as 颐和园 (S422, lead)
properties.size: area 301.2 ha (run on osm way 29228773; zh.wiki 297 ha, S422)
properties.position_basis: osm way 29228773 centroid (颐和园 heritage boundary)
properties.note: S05 j84: 建于万寿山之麓, 在圆明园西二里许, 前为昆明湖; main gate five bays facing east, 勤政殿 seven bays. Built 1750-64. Today's outline follows the 1880s-90s wall: in 1860 only the hill part was walled and the lake shores were open (S02 p.199: the Guangxu work 'complete[d] a wall around the whole garden and lake'), so the outline is a C stand-in for the 1860 extent. Massing: 大报恩延寿寺 / the tower site on the hill's south axis (延寿塔 pulled down at the 8th storey, replaced by 佛香阁, S422 lead), the long gallery, 宝云阁 (bronze, 1755) and 智慧海 (glazed brick) which survived the fire (lead). Free pictures: Beato Oct 1860 (S643, S282: 文昌阁) and see the sources file.; Pictures before the burning: Beato 智慧海 (S1209), 多宝琉璃塔 (S1209), a pavilion (S1209), 文昌阁 (S643), 十七孔桥 and 南湖岛 (S1210); after it: the empty 佛香阁 terrace and a lake panorama (S1211); ruins 1868-89 by Thomson and Child (S281, S1213). Also: AMS 1944 sheet read at px 1735,450, fit rms 95 m (Wanshowshan (Yihoyüan)), 356 m from the point used. Also: LoC Beijing cheng jiao tu c.1886 read at px 6987,3316, fit rms 226 m (萬壽山), 811 m from the point used.

properties.name_en: Garden of Tranquil Brightness (玉泉山 Yuquan Shan)
properties.state_1860: looted before 18 Oct, burned 18-19 Oct 1860 by British troops (S02 p.189; 瑞常's memorial 26 Oct via S1207); again damaged 1900 (S1201 lead); c.1930 'kept without much change as it was after the fires' (S02 p.218)
properties.size: the OSM wood on the hill, way 989069291, 39.6 ha (run): not the garden's wall
properties.position_basis: osm node 8725437667 (玉泉山 peak)
properties.note: S05 j85: 在玉泉山之阳, Kangxi-era, 16 views; gate five bays facing south, the 高水湖 before it. Pagodas on the hill (玉峰塔) are the skyline mark from our gardens. Closed today (lead).; Built 1680 as 澄心园, renamed 静明园 1692 (S1201 lead). Picture: Beato's 玉峰塔 with the rubble wall (S1212), and the pagoda on the skyline of S1211. Also: AMS 1944 sheet read at px 1389,470, fit rms 95 m (Yütsüanshan (Tsingmingyüan)), 98 m from the point used. Also: LoC Beijing cheng jiao tu c.1886 read at px 6822,3363, fit rms 226 m (玉泉山), 270 m from the point used.

properties.name_en: Garden of Joyful Spring (Kangxi's garden; not our 长春园)
properties.state_1860: decayed by the Daoguang reign; from 1843 a subsidiary garden; its NW part taken into 承泽园 1845; in 1856 (Xianfeng 6) many buildings pulled down for their timber (S685, table 1); 清溪书屋, 恩佑寺, 恩慕寺 burned Oct 1860 (明善's memorial via S1207); levelled 1909 as a drill ground (S02 p.215)
properties.size: wall 1,060 zhang, about 3,390 m round (S05 j76; S02 p.21 '10,600 Chinese feet'); polygon 65.6 ha, 3,399 m (run); zh.wiki 1000 x 600 m, 60 ha (S1200, lead)
properties.position_basis: geo polygon, C: Song 2021 Fig. 5 wall line (S685, CC BY 4.0), anchored on the 恩佑寺 gate (osm way 169215123), scaled to the 1,060-zhang wall of S05 j76
properties.note: S05 j76: 在南海淀大河庄之北; 因在圆明园之南亦名前园. Gate of five bays with east and west 朝房, a stream round it (j76); Malone puts the gate in the middle of the south side (p.22), zh.wiki on the south wall's east side (disagreement). Inside: 九经三事殿, 春晖堂, 寿萱春永 (the empress dowager's), 前湖 and 后湖, the 丁香堤, 兰芝堤, 桃花堤, 清溪书屋 (Kangxi died there 1722), 无逸斋 by the west wall with vegetable plots and rice fields inside (j76); boat dock outside the south wall (j76; S02 p.103). The best outline lead: Malone's sketch map p.23 from Wen Chi-ju's manuscript map (S23, research-only) and Song 2021 (S685, CC BY). Survivors: the 恩佑寺 and 恩慕寺 gates and the NE boundary stele (S1202).; Picture lead: the 1717 birthday procession woodblocks show the gate and bell tower (S02 p.104; S1214, leaf not located).; Malone's sketch p.22 (S23) puts the gate with shadow walls in the middle of the south side, 恩慕寺 and 恩佑寺 inside the east wall's north part, the bell tower by the SE corner and the 火神庙 across the road; its shape is about 1.33 : 1 (N-S : E-W), i.e. about 970 x 730 m: disagreement with the C polygon (880 x 760 m) and zh.wiki (1000 x 600 m).; Song 2021 (S685, CC BY 4.0, read this round): the two temple gates stand on the east wall near its NE corner; the 恩佑寺 gate is turned about 12 degrees from the 恩慕寺 gate, so the east wall is not straight; the south wall from the archaeological plan of the 大宫门 site; the imperial road is today's 颐和园路. His Fig. 5 scale bar gives about 750 x 1,200-1,400 m (4.1 km round), against the 3,390 m of j76: scaled down here (disagreement). Our polygon then puts the SE corner about 160 m south of the 火神庙 (Malone p.21 puts it at the road in front of that temple).
